personal.preferred_title: AWS / PySpark Data Engineer | Lakehouse Migration, SQL Optimization & Data Quality

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across AWS data platforms, Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, ETL/ELT, data migration, reconciliation, data quality validation, Hadoop/Hive concepts, Parquet-based lakehouse patterns, and production reporting systems. Strong background transforming legacy/on-prem data workflows into scalable cloud analytics platforms using S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Oracle, Spark/PySpark, partitioning, schema design, and SQL optimization. Best aligned to AWS lakehouse migration roles requiring practical data engineering, large-scale processing, data quality, and stakeholder-ready reporting; Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, and Kubernetes are positioned as adjacent or active learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer

Built Python/Pandas/PySpark ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated datasets for business and technical stakeholders.
Migrated heavy forecasting and analytics workloads from on-prem Oracle patterns toward AWS/Redshift-backed processing, improving scalability and enabling cloud-based reporting workflows.
Applied Parquet, partitioning concepts, schema design, and SQL optimization patterns to improve large-scale data processing and reporting access.
Designed SQL reporting structures, historical retention schemas, and queryable data layers that made complex infrastructure telemetry easier to analyze and consume.
Built data quality, reconciliation, and validation practices across BMC TrueSight, CA Wily, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed reporting layers to improve trust in pipeline outputs.
Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, partitioning patterns, retention strategy, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware access.
Documented pipeline logic, metric definitions, operational runbooks, data interpretation notes, and support steps to improve governance and production readiness.
